Predict one human dictator's monetary allocation choice. Two allocations are available; each is a complete ordered pair of monetary outcomes for you and an anonymous other person. You choose one complete allocation directly and the other person cannot reject it. The menu is for your private decision. Positive numbers mean gains and negative numbers mean losses in Chinese yuan (CNY). Preserve each signed amount exactly; there is no assumed fixed sum and the two components cannot be chosen independently. The recipient receives no information revealing your identity or choice.
The experiment includes dictator and message games in gain and loss contexts, in four separate blocks of 12 decisions, 48 decisions in total. This record concerns only a dictator allocation. Participants were told that decisions would be implemented approximately 80% of the time in both games, and no outcome feedback would be presented. One trial is randomly selected in each of the four conditions to determine the final gain or loss. The remaining implementation mechanism, fixed compensation, initial resources for losses, original display arrangement and actual block/trial order are not supplied in the available materials; do not invent them. Prior own choices and the current temporal position are unrecorded here, not assumed unknown to the participant. The amounts below are the author's recorded payoff amounts; original screen precision is not independently documented. No individual demographic attributes are linked to these rows, so none are imputed.
Predict the recorded human choice, not an optimal, fair or morally recommended action. Return only a JSON object with exactly the numeric fields self_CNY and recipient_CNY for one of the two complete available allocations. Do not add an explanation.
